title: Income-Loss Settlement Standard, Host Damage Protection (HostCover)
content:
**Host Damage Protection (HostCover): settlement of an approved income-loss claim.**

The income-loss settlement starts from the loss the claims team verified on the approved income-loss claim. A stay bears its deductible once: each claim of the stay that already carries a reimbursement has borne an equal share of it, that share being the plan level's deductible divided by the number of approved claims filed on the stay, and the income-loss claim bears the part of the level's deductible those reimbursed claims have not borne. From the verified lost income, every guest payment recorded on the income-loss claim, net of reversals, is subtracted together with the deductible the income-loss claim bears. The result is floored at 0.00 and then cut to the lower of the level's per-claim limit and the plan's remaining aggregate, which is the level's annual aggregate limit less the reimbursements, net of recoveries, posted on the plan in the current plan year; income loss carries no category sublimit. The income-loss settlement is rounded half up to the nearest cent only at the end.

## Definitions used in the standard

- **Claims of the stay**: the approved claims filed on the stay the income-loss claim arose from.
- **Reimbursed claims of the stay**: those of them on which the plan's HostCover ledger shows a reimbursement.
- **Deductible the income-loss claim bears**: the level's deductible multiplied by the number of claims of the stay not yet reimbursed and divided by the number of claims of the stay.

## Worked figure (hypothetical inputs, not the figures of any level)

The stay carries three approved claims, the income-loss claim among them. The level deductible is 240.00.

| Reimbursed claims of the stay | Deductible the income-loss claim bears |
|---|---|
| none | 240.00 |
| one | 160.00 |
| two | 80.00 |

With two of the stay's claims already reimbursed, a verified lost income of 2100.00 and guest payments on the income-loss claim of 0.00: 2100.00 less 80.00 gives 2020.00. The per-claim limit is 50000.00 and the remaining aggregate 46000.00, so the income-loss settlement is 2020.00.
